items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Joe Turner was an influence in my life, but I could never stride the way...

ctx.x: what... Hey, that became... you know, it was my stimulation, I mean, to hear these Jazz pianists around...you know, Jazz itself.

Then later on, when I became a little bit more grown, I met Joe Turner. Joe Turner was an influence in my life, but I could never stride the way... I tried to copy everything that he did, you know. But he was so good and he was so kind to me. He was a real buddy when I was young. He was very encouraging. And as I began...
How much older would he be than you?
